The Laser is time limited campaign. It take place in location New Guinea.

Text: "New weapons are revealed."

Time to complete: 72h

Number of mission: 5.

Enemy base HP : Shattered Sun 80/100/120

Enemy encounter: [[Guerilla Tank]], [[Stingray]], [[Raptor]], [[Thunderbird]], [[Fury]], [[Auroch]], [[Savage Stingray]]

Enemy equipment: Reinforced Hull, Fortifired Hull

Reward: [[Scorpion]]

During the event the [[Laser Crate]] is available.

The is also a Stingray pack.

Cost: 100 Kreds

Contents: 75 Volt Coins, 75 Scraps, [[Stingray]]
